files.title: S.Y.B.Sc. (Statistics)
files.programme: S. Y. B. Sc. / S. Y. B. A. Statistics

subjects.title: Expectation of bivariate Probability Distribution and Discrete Probability Distributions

units.title: Mathematical Expectation (Bivariate Random Variable)
units.topics: 1.1 Definition of raw and central moments, moment generating function (m.g.f), cumulant generating function (c.g.f.). 1.2 Theorems on expectations of sum and product of two jointly distributed random variables. 1.3 Conditional expectation. 1.4 Definitions of conditional mean and conditional variance. 1.5 Definition of covariance, coefficient of correlation, independence and uncorrelatedness of two variables. 1.6 Variance of linear combination of variables Var(aX + bY). 1.7 Numerical examples

units.title: Poisson distribution
units.topics: 2.1 Notation: X ~ P(m), Probability mass function (p. m. f.) of the distribution. 2.2 M. G. F. and C. G. F. Raw and central moments, mean and variance from M.G.F. & C.G.F. Skewness and kurtosis. 2.4 Situations where this distribution is applicable. 2.5 Additive property. 2.6 Conditional distribution of X given (X+Y). 2.7 Numerical examples

units.title: Geometric distribution
units.topics: 3.1 Notation: X ~ G(p), Geometric distribution on support (0, 1, 2, ...,) and (1, 2,. . .). 3.3 Situations where this distribution is applicable. 3.4 Distribution function and lack of memory property. 3.5 M. G. F. and C. G. F. Mean and variance from M.G.F. & C.G.F. 3.6 Numerical examples.

units.title: Negative Binomial Distribution
units.topics: 4.1 Probability mass function (p. m. f.), Notation X ~ NB(k,p). 4.2 Graphical nature of p.m.f. 4.3 Negative binomial distribution as a waiting time distribution. 4.4 M. G. F. and C. G. F. Mean and variance from M.G.F. & C.G.F. Skewness, kurtosis. 4.5 Additive property. 4.6 Relation between geometric distribution and negative binomial distribution. 4.7 Poisson approximation to negative binomial distribution. Real life situations. 4.8 Numerical problems.

units.title: Multinomial Distribution
units.topics: 5.1 Probability mass function (p.m.f.), Notations. 5.2 Joint MGF of (X1, X2, . . ., Xk). Mean, variance, covariance, total correlation coefficient, variance – covariance matrix from joint MGF. Rank of variance – covariance matrix and its interpretation. 5.3 Additive property. 5.4 Univariate marginal distribution, distribution of Xi + Xj. 5.5 Conditional distribution of Xi given Xj = r. 5.6 Conditional distribution of Xi given Xi + Xj= r. 5.7 Numerical problems.

units.title: Continuous Univariate Distributions
units.topics: 1.1 Continuous sample space: Definition and illustrations. 1.2 Continuous random variable: Definition, probability density function (p.d.f.), cumulative distribution function (c.d.f.), properties of c.d.f. 1.3 Expectation of continuous r.v., moments, raw and central moments, skewness and kurtosis. 1.4 Moment generating function (M.G.F.), cumulant generating function (C.G.F.). 1.5 Transformation of continuous variables. 1.6 Numerical examples.

units.title: Continuous Bivariate Distributions
units.topics: 2.1 Definition of two-dimensional continuous random variable (X, Y), its joint p.d.f. and properties. 2.2 Marginal and conditional distributions, conditional expectation. 2.3 Independence of random variables, covariance and correlation coefficient. 2.4 Bivariate transformations. 2.5 Numerical examples.

units.title: Standard Univariate Continuous Distributions
units.topics: 3.1 Uniform distribution: p.d.f., c.d.f., moments, MGF. 3.2 Exponential distribution: p.d.f., c.d.f., moments, MGF, lack of memory property. 3.3 Normal distribution: p.d.f., standard normal distribution, properties of normal curve, mean, variance, MGF, CGF, moments, area property, central limit theorem.

units.title: Standard Discrete Probability Distributions
units.topics: Negative Binomial and Geometric distribution: p.m.f., mean, variance, MGF, CGF, applications and properties.

units.title: Continuous Univariate Distributions
units.topics: Continuous sample space, continuous random variable, p.d.f., c.d.f., moments, MGF, transformations.

units.title: Standard Continuous Probability Distributions
units.topics: Uniform, Exponential, and Normal distribution: definitions, properties, and applications.

units.title: Demography
units.topics: Introduction, vital statistics, measurement of mortality: CDR, SDR, IMR. Measurement of fertility: CBR, GFR, ASFR, TFR. Reproduction rates: GRR, NRR.

subjects.title: Statistics Practical on Probability Distributions and Demography

units.title: Time Series
units.topics: Meaning and utility of time series, components of time series, additive and multiplicative models, measurement of trend: moving averages and least squares method.

units.title: Theory of Attributes
units.topics: Notation, dichotomy, classes and class frequencies, consistency of data, independence and association of attributes, Yule's coefficient of association.

units.title: Demography:
units.topics: Introduction, sources of demographic data, mortality and fertility rates, reproduction rates.

units.title: Tabulation
units.topics: Data collection, classification and tabulation, frequency distributions.

units.title: Graphical and diagrammatic representation of the data
units.topics: Bar diagrams, pie charts, histograms, frequency polygon, ogive curves.

units.title: Measures of Central Tendency
units.topics: Mean, median, mode, geometric mean, harmonic mean, partition values.

units.title: Measures of Dispersion
units.topics: Range, quartile deviation, mean deviation, standard deviation, variance, coefficient of variation.

subjects.title: Evolution / Development of Statistics in India

units.title: Historical Background of Statistics in India
units.topics: Ancient Indian contributions to counting, estimation, and data collection; Arthashastra by Kautilya and Ain-i-Akbari.

units.title: Evolution of Modern Statistical Systems in India
units.topics: Contributions of P. C. Mahalanobis, establishment of Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), National Sample Survey (NSS), Central Statistical Organisation (CSO).

units.title: Applications of Statistics in Indian Context
units.topics: Agricultural statistics, demographic surveys, economic planning and Five-Year Plans.

units.title: Testing of Statistical Hypotheses & Tests Based on Normal Distribution and Large Sample Tests
units.topics: Statistical hypothesis, simple and composite hypotheses, null and alternative hypotheses, two types of errors, critical region, level of significance, p-value. Tests for single mean, difference of means, single proportion, difference of proportions.

units.title: Multiple Linear Regression Model:
units.topics: Multiple linear regression with two independent variables, estimation of parameters using least squares method, coefficient of multiple determination, partial correlation coefficients.

units.title: Time series analysis
units.topics: Components of time series, estimation of trend, moving averages, exponential smoothing, measurement of seasonal variations.

units.title: Gamma Distribution
units.topics: Definition of Gamma r.v., p.d.f., properties, moments, MGF, additive property.

units.title: Chi-square Distribution
units.topics: Definition, derivation of p.d.f., moments, MGF, additive property, use of chi-square tables.

units.title: Student’s – t distribution
units.topics: Definition of Student's t-statistic, p.d.f., moments, properties, use of t-tables.

units.title: Snedecor’s F – distribution
units.topics: Definition of F-statistic, p.d.f., moments, properties, use of F-tables.

units.title: Tests of Hypothesis based on sampling distributions
units.topics: Chi-square test for goodness of fit, test for independence of attributes, test for population variance. t-test for single mean, difference of means, paired t-test. F-test for equality of two variances.

units.title: Sampling Distributions
units.topics: Chi-square, t and F distributions: definitions, properties, interrelations.

units.title: Testing of Hypothesis
units.topics: Concepts of hypothesis testing, null and alternative hypotheses, type I and II errors, critical region, p-value.

units.title: Tests based on normal distribution
units.topics: Large sample tests for mean and proportion.

units.title: Tests based on sampling distributions
units.topics: Exact tests: chi-square, t, and F tests in applications.

subjects.title: Practical on Sampling Distributions and Statistical Inference

units.title: Index Number
units.topics: Definition, problems in construction, simple and weighted index numbers: Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher, Marshall-Edgeworth, Dorbish-Bowley index numbers, tests of consistency.

units.title: Concepts and definitions related to testing of hypothesis
units.topics: Hypothesis testing concepts, large sample tests in business decision making.

units.title: Preparation of Questionnaires
units.topics: Principles of designing a questionnaire, pre-testing, data collection techniques.

units.title: Index Number
units.topics: Index numbers: types, construction, applications in economic and business analysis.

units.title: Concepts and definitions related to testing of hypothesis
units.topics: Hypothesis formulation, tests of significance in applied research.

units.title: Time Series
units.topics: Introduction, components, additive and multiplicative models, trend estimation using moving averages.
